title: The hub sets deputies only on the owner's words, sets one up with one form from what the person does, and routes a card in away only when it lies wholly in one deputy's area (spec d2679763, part A)
note: Invented names (Masha Kim of the map tiles frontend, Boris Lee of ruby backends, session maps-dev). The rules are new: run --only after. The system prompt is hub-home/CLAUDE.md of the version; the core's words come as the constants of the version (AWAY_CARD, AWAY_RULE, HUB_DEPUTIES). Checks: a form and no write on «set up», the owner's words quoted on «X decides Y», nothing on «do not make», --deputies with --for on «questions to the deputies», route only for a card wholly in one area that is not a gate, not mixed, not the deputy's own request.
